title: Found the security code for Mall World
content: Had a Mall World dream last night, only this time it took place at night when it was closed and empty. A friend whose name and face I do not know or remember was with me and encouraged me to go inside. I remember the parking lot being wet like it had just rained and there were cigarette butts laying there. Anyway, when I told my "friend" I didn't know the security code, he said, "Of course you do. It's 'Megan', just like your friends name.". The security pad didn't have letters, only numbers, so I spelled out Megan by what letter matched it's number in sequential order. In case we're all dreaming about the same mall? The code to get inside after hours is 13-5-7-1-14
